skills.name: Blood Bolt
skills.text: Hurl a bolt of your own blood at a foe within {range} tiles for {dmg} Physical damage.

variants.name: Haemorrhage
variants.text: The bolt tears the wound open: the foe gains {bleed} Bleed stacks.

variants.name: Siphon
variants.text: You heal for {healPct}% of the damage the bolt deals.

variants.name: Splitting
variants.text: On impact the bolt forks to {forks} more foes within {forkRange} tiles, striking each for {forkPct}% of its damage.

skills.name: Sanguine Pact
skills.text: Your spells deal {spellPct}% more damage. When you lack the Mana for a skill, the shortfall is paid in Life at {lifePerMana} Life per Mana.

skills.name: Crimson Nova
skills.text: Spend {life} Life to burst outward in a crimson wave: {dmg} Physical damage to every foe within {radius} tiles.

variants.name: Clotting
variants.text: The spilled blood clots into a barrier worth {barrierMult} times the Life spent, lasting {turns} turns.

variants.name: Rupture
variants.text: Bleeding foes caught in the wave burst, dealing {burst} Physical damage to foes within {burstRadius} tile of them.

skills.name: Vein Tap
skills.text: Tether a foe within {range} tiles for {turns} turns. Each turn the tether drains {dot} Physical damage and heals you for all of it. It snaps if the foe moves more than {range} tiles away or out of sight.

variants.name: Chain
variants.text: You hold {tethers} tethers at once: the second reaches the nearest other foe in range.

variants.name: Feast
variants.text: The tether also restores Mana equal to {manaPct}% of what it drains.

variants.name: Overdrain
variants.text: When the tether ends, the foe bursts for {burst} Physical damage to every foe within {burstRadius} tile.

skills.name: Exsanguinate
skills.text: Call in the blood you have spilled: every Bleed stack on foes in sight is consumed, each dealing {dmg} Physical damage to its bearer.

variants.name: Red Harvest
variants.text: You heal {healPct}% of your max Life for every stack consumed.

variants.name: Spray
variants.text: First, every Bleeding foe spreads {spread} Bleed stack to the foes beside it.

variants.name: Pressure
variants.text: Foes above {lifeAbove}% Life take {bonusPct}% more damage from it.

skills.name: Hemomancy
skills.text: The closer you are to death, the harder you strike: up to {dmgPct}% more damage, in proportion to your missing Life.

skills.name: Blood Moon
skills.text: For {turns} turns a blood moon rises: your spells cost Life instead of Mana, one for one, and deal {dmgPct}% more damage, and every kill restores {killHealPct}% of your max Life.

variants.name: Eclipse
variants.text: While the moon is up you gain {critPct}% critical chance.

variants.name: Tide
variants.text: Your thralls receive {sharePct}% of the healing you receive.

variants.name: Red Rain
variants.text: Each turn of the moon, a free Blood Bolt strikes a random foe in sight.

skills.name: Ichor Engine
skills.text: Healing beyond your max Life becomes a barrier that holds up to {overhealBarrierPct}% of your max Life. The barrier thins by {decayPct}% each turn.

strings.tree.desc: Spend your own Life on spells of blood, then drink it back from your foes.
strings.buff.vein_tap.name: Vein Tap
strings.buff.vein_tap.desc: A thread of blood ties this creature to the Occultist. Each turn it loses {dot} Life to him; {turns} turns remain.
strings.buff.clotting.name: Clotted Blood
strings.buff.clotting.desc: A crust of clotted blood takes the blows meant for you: {barrier} damage, for {turns} more turns.
strings.buff.blood_moon.name: Blood Moon
strings.buff.blood_moon.desc: A red moon rides overhead. Your spells are paid in Life instead of Mana and strike {pct}% harder, and every kill gives back {heal} Life. {turns} turns remain.
strings.buff.ichor.name: Ichor Barrier
strings.buff.ichor.desc: Surplus healing has hardened into a barrier that holds {barrier} damage. It thins by {pct}% every turn.
